facts.fact: The State Department for Lands and Physical Planning says that from 20 July 2026 all land transactions in the newly onboarded Mombasa registration sections are processed exclusively on the live Ardhisasa platform and manual processing ceases there, after earlier rollouts in Nairobi (2021), Murang'a, Isiolo, Mombasa Island and Mombasa Blocks XVI and XVII (21 July 2025).

The State Department for Lands and Physical Planning says it is progressively expanding the National Land Information Management System (Ardhisasa) to more registration sections and remains committed to a nationwide rollout.
